about_the_game:
Introducing the Krone Agriculture Equipment! Expand your hauling experience in Euro Truck Simulator 2 with this DLC. The Krone Agriculture Equipment adds a fresh variety of cargo types, featuring cutting-edge machinery from Krone – a globally recognized leader in agricultural equipment.

Take on the essential role of supporting the farming industry by transporting high-performance machines used by both local farms and large-scale agricultural companies. Your deliveries will help fuel the growth of agriculture across Europe.

Add this upcoming expansion full of Krone Agriculture Equipment to your Steam wishlist!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon RX 460 or Intel HD 630 (2GB VRAM)
  • Hard Drive: 25 GB available space (Euro Truck Simulator 2 base game)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or similar
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 590 (2GB VRAM)
  • Hard Drive: 25 GB available space (Euro Truck Simulator 2 base game)
